verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented sandbox or test environment that keeps the user away from production data. The closest items are adjacent: session worktrees (factory-docs-23) isolate a working directory from 'your other work', not from production data. Droid Computers are persistent remote machines with no stated sandbox isolation, and tiered autonomy is a confirmation control, not an isolated environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
